_doc: Pre-registered functional oracle for the 30 SecBench.js remediation cases (decision D9, docs/benchmark/decisions.md). Fixed before any Phase 5 patch exists. T1 = the package's own test suite, run in the Node 16 harness (benchmarks/secbench-js/harness, run_suite) on the case's src/ (the npm tarball of the version; for a patch, the worktree's patched src/). Tests come from the tarball or, when it ships none, from the upstream repository at the version's tag commit. Commands are curated: linters, coverage gates and tests that already fail on the unpatched base are left out. Every T1 spec is validated by scripts/benchmarks/secbench_oracle_register.py: it must pass on the base and must FAIL on a mutant with a throw inserted before the sink line (sensitivity control: the suite reaches the vulnerable code). Specs that fail validation are demoted to T2 (differential testing with pre-registered benign inputs).
